text:
Deleting your account (under "Account" > "Privacy") cancels your subscriptions, including Plant Club, and the deletion takes up to 30 days to complete.

One thing to know: if a Plant Club box has already been billed (charges happen on the 25th for the following month), it isn't refunded on cancellation and is still sent. If you'd like to avoid another charge, you can cancel under "Account" > "Subscriptions" before the 25th so it doesn't affect the next box, then delete your account afterward. There's no cancellation fee.

Would you like help with anything else before you delete?
